description: This file defines the class tlRequirementFilterControl, which extends tlFilterControl. It manages filters and settings for requirement trees in the TestLink project, including configuration, initialization, and tree building functions. It contains all logic specific to requirement filtering UI controls and their processing.

classes.name: tlRequirementFilterControl
classes.description: Class extending tlFilterControl to handle requirement tree filters, including configuration, initialization, and building requirement tree menus with filtering options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter control, requirement manager, and filters.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up requirement manager object.

methods.name: read_config
methods.description: Reads configuration related to requirement filters.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes arguments and parameters for user input parsing.

methods.name: init_settings
methods.description: Initializes settings based on configuration and user input.

methods.name: init_filters
methods.description: Initializes filters based on configuration and user input.

methods.name: get_active_filters
methods.description: Returns the currently active filters for tree generation.

methods.name: build_tree_menu
methods.description: Builds the requirement tree menu, either filtered or lazy-loaded, for GUI display.

methods.name: init_setting_refresh_tree_on_action
methods.description: Initializes the refresh tree setting based on input and configuration.

methods.name: init_filter_doc_id
methods.description: Initializes the document ID filter based on user input.

methods.name: init_filter_status
methods.description: Initializes the status filter with status labels.

methods.name: init_filter_type
methods.description: Initializes the type filter with type labels.

methods.name: init_filter_spec_type
methods.description: Initializes the requirement specification type filter.

methods.name: init_filter_coverage
methods.description: Initializes the coverage filter if coverage management is enabled.

methods.name: init_filter_relation
methods.description: Initializes the relation filter if relations are enabled, including relation type selection.

methods.name: init_filter_tc_id
methods.description: Initializes the test case ID filter based on project prefix.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Retrieves linked custom fields for requirements in the specified test project.
